assets.title: Aperture Ball Toss Table
assets.description: One complete static carnival ball toss table, counted as one prop. A 25-degree inclined 65 mm thick connected target board has four real polygonal circular through-holes, each with continuous visible inner walls and a flush ochre material rim. The holes are geometry, not black discs. Two separate side rails and sloped side cheeks carry the board over a collection cavity with a solid floor, side and rear walls and an open front retrieval side above a low lip. Four separate upright legs, two side stretchers and two cross stretchers connect the assembly to four finite floor-contact patches. The below-board cavity and all four target passages are genuinely empty. Editable closed meshes, opaque constant PBR colours, metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No textures, labels, characters, loose balls, ring posts, basketball hoop, pinball mechanisms or surrounding scene. Static visual geometry only. No throwing trajectory, ball motion, bounce, hole-entry probability, automatic ball return, scoring, payment, game rules, gameplay completeness, human fit, load capacity, anti-tip performance, operation, amusement-facility or child safety certification. No legacy ball or scene compatibility claim. Dimensions define visual geometry only.
